causalAutopsy.notes: The Phase 4 acceptance manifest relied on a floating substring to assert a numeric result population. Exit-code behavior masked the defect, but an exit-zero empty run was not independently refused and `0 fail` also matched `10 fail`.

guardEvidence.howCaught: Marker-backed exit-zero controls prove that the gate rejects the legacy `10 fail` text claim, a structured one-failure claim, and a zero-result claim, while accepting only the exact seven-result all-pass contract.
